method: BASELINE. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

checks.command: l4 run gaa-incapacity.l4 ; l4 run gaa-cases-incapacity.l4 ; l4 run gaa-qa.l4 ; l4 run gaa-qa-cases.l4 ; l4 check gaa-qa.l4
checks.result: 404 assertions satisfied (68 baseline + 336 Q&A layer, 2026-11-06), 0 errors, 0 warnings in all four files; l4 check gaa-qa.l4: Check succeeded; parameter script: 47 exports, my role first everywhere, each situation input second and identical wherever taken, one type and @desc per input name, no DEONTIC or EVENT input
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Planning for one's own incapacity and being made the subject of an order: Part 9 (ss 104, 104B, 104C, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109; Schedule 3 Forms 1-2), Part 9A (ss 110B-110H, 110N; regs 6, 8, Schedule 1), Part 9B (ss 110P-110T; regs 7-9, Schedule 2), s 110ZD (person responsible), s 110ZJ and s 119 (orders of priority), s 45 (functions borrowed by s 110G), ss 53(a), 54 (via s 110H), s 4(3)-(4), s 43 (guardianship order) and s 64 (administration order). Out: the Tribunal's procedure, reviews and appeals; limited guardians' and administrators' functions; sterilisation; the Public Advocate; recognition of other jurisdictions' instruments; urgent treatment; abortion; medical research.
seat: the adult planning for incapacity (the donor of an enduring power of attorney, the appointor of an enduring guardian, the maker of an advance health directive) and the person for whom a guardian or administrator may be appointed

roles: I am planning for my own incapacity, or a guardian or administrator may be appointed for me
I am, or have been asked to be, someone's attorney under an enduring power of attorney
I am, or have been asked to be, someone's enduring guardian
I am the partner, relative, carer or friend of someone who may need treatment decided for them

situation_parameters.name: I have made an enduring power of attorney
questions: Is my enduring power of attorney valid
Is my enduring power of attorney in force now
Can the Tribunal declare that I lack legal capacity
Has my substitute attorney become my attorney yet
What is the most my attorney can be fined for not keeping records and accounts
May my attorney renounce my enduring power of attorney
What happens to my power of attorney if an administrator is appointed

situation_parameters.name: I have made an enduring power of guardianship
questions: Is my enduring power of guardianship valid under the Act
May my enduring guardian act for me at this time
May my enduring guardian make this decision about me
Must my joint enduring guardians all agree
May my surviving joint enduring guardians act after a death

situation_parameters.name: I have made an advance health directive
questions: Was the form of my directive the prescribed form
Is my advance health directive valid under the Act
Is this treatment decision of mine valid
Is this treatment decision of mine revoked
Does this treatment decision of mine operate now

situation_parameters.name: I have been appointed someone's attorney under an enduring power of attorney
questions: Is the enduring power of attorney I hold in force
Have I become the attorney as substitute
Must I keep records and accounts as attorney
What is the most I can be fined for not keeping records as attorney
May I renounce the enduring power of attorney
Am I liable to the donor for a loss
Must I report my bankruptcy to the Tribunal

situation_parameters.name: I have been appointed someone's enduring guardian
questions: May I act as enduring guardian now
May I make this decision as enduring guardian

situation_parameters.name: I am one of two or more joint enduring guardians
questions: Must we joint enduring guardians all agree before acting
May we surviving joint enduring guardians act

situation_parameters.name: treatment is proposed for them and they cannot make reasonable judgments about it
questions: Do I decide whether the patient gets the treatment
